rows.action: Kate speaks the line to camera, head steady with a slight turn toward the radio dial, right hand resting on the dial. No body movement beyond head and hand.
rows.camera_movement: Static. No pan, tilt, dolly or zoom.
rows.camera_position: Eye level, 1.2 m from Kate, straight on.
rows.composition: Kate centre frame, chest up, radio desk across the bottom third, warm lamp glow right, snow window soft behind left shoulder.
rows.continuity_note: C01 face, hair, navy jacket and cream sweater must match portrait.png. Brass ring on lanyard visible.
rows.cut_type: Hard cut in from black; first shot of the test film.
rows.eye_trace: Viewer starts on Kate's eyes, drops to her hand on the dial on 'holding', returns to her eyes for 'it knows we are listening'.
rows.light: Warm tungsten lamp key from the right, cool blue snow fill from the window left.
rows.sound: Kate's voice (Piper kristin), room tone, faint radio static under the line.
rows.title: Kate: the signal is holding

rows.action: James enters through the door at frame left and walks across the room to Kate at the radio desk at frame right. Kate turns her head toward him as he arrives in the last 1.5 s. James stops beside the desk.
rows.camera_movement: Dolly right, tracking James, eye level, with a slow pan left to right keeping James centre frame.
rows.camera_position: Eye level, 1.6 m high, starting 0.5 m left of centre, ending 2.5 m right of centre, 7 m back from the room.
rows.composition: Wide landscape. Door frame left, empty floor centre, radio desk right. James crosses the empty middle third. Kate seated at the desk right.
rows.continuity_note: C02 orange-red survival suit and ear-flap hat must match portrait.png; C01 navy jacket must match portrait.png. Door, desk and lamp positions must match the Blender blockout.
rows.eye_trace: Viewer follows James from the door across the empty floor; the eye lands on Kate only when she turns, in the final 1.5 s.
rows.light: Same room as P0-A1: warm lamp right, cool snow fill left. No lighting change between shots.
rows.movement_reason: The dolly exists to keep James in frame while he crosses; without it he would exit frame right before reaching Kate. The move is the point of the shot — this is why it is Lane B.
rows.sound: Silent. Footsteps and room tone are not required for the motion test; audio track is silence.
rows.title: James crosses to Kate
